spec.hidden_tests_patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_explicit_checked_rendering.py
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+import pytest
+
+from wtforms.fields import BooleanField
+from wtforms.fields import RadioField
+from wtforms.form import Form
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("field_type", [BooleanField, RadioField])
+def test_checked_precedence(field_type):
+    kwargs = {"choices": [("a", "A"), ("b", "B")]} if field_type is RadioField else {}
+    class F(Form):
+        item = field_type(render_kw={"checked": False}, **kwargs)
+
+    form = F(item="a" if field_type is RadioField else True)
+    node = next(iter(form.item)) if field_type is RadioField else form.item
+    assert ' checked' not in str(node())
+    assert ' checked' not in str(node(checked=False))
+    assert ' checked' in str(node(checked=True))
+    assert form.item.data == ("a" if field_type is RadioField else True)
+    if field_type is RadioField:
+        assert node.checked is True
+
+    other = F(item="b" if field_type is RadioField else False)
+    node = next(iter(other.item)) if field_type is RadioField else other.item
+    assert ' checked' not in str(node())
+    assert ' checked' in str(node(checked=True))
+    assert other.item.data == ("b" if field_type is RadioField else False)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("field_type", [BooleanField, RadioField])
+def test_checked_default(field_type):
+    kwargs = {"choices": [("a", "A"), ("b", "B")]} if field_type is RadioField else {}
+    class F(Form):
+        item = field_type(**kwargs)
+    form = F(item="a" if field_type is RadioField else True)
+    node = next(iter(form.item)) if field_type is RadioField else form.item
+    assert ' checked' in str(node())
+    assert ' checked' not in str(node(checked=False))
spec.notes: RadioField call-time attributes apply to its list wrapper; the request deliberately targets the individual bound options. The tests use public iteration to obtain them.
spec.question: Allow explicit rendering attributes to override automatic checked state. For `BooleanField` and individual options obtained by iterating a `RadioField`, an explicit `checked=False` must suppress the HTML attribute even when the field or option is selected. This must work both through `render_kw` defaults and through arguments supplied when calling the bound field or option, with call-time arguments taking precedence. Explicit `checked=True` must still render the attribute for an unselected value. When no checked attribute is supplied, retain the current automatic behavior. Rendering must not change field data or a radio option's checked state. Deliver a unified diff changing production files only.
